exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 to 1.
Positive serum pregnancy test or participant who is breastfeeding.
Have known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or leptomeningeal disease (LMD).
Have active hepatitis B virus (HBV) or hepatitis C virus (HCV), or HIV.
Myocardial infarction or unstable angina pectoris within 6 months of enrollment.
Mean QT interval corrected for heart rate using the Fridericia's formula (QTcF) ≥ 470 msec.
New York Heart Association Class \> III congestive heart failure or known left ventricular ejection fraction \< 40%.
